highlights.description: New `lightsail-instance` target: a persistent AWS Lightsail VM running your binary as a systemd service, for workloads that need a local file (SQLite, sessions) to survive a redeploy — something the LightSail Container Service target can't provide
Deploy-time secret resolution (`SecretRef`) wired through the runtime adapter and into the LightSail target, plus a remote `.env`/systemd `EnvironmentFile=` injection path for the new instance target
Post-deploy health verification: an HTTP retry probe after a deployment reaches ACTIVE, plus a systemd `is-active` retry loop for the instance target's non-HTTP workloads

added.description: `lightsail-instance` Pulumi resource graph: instance, SSH keypair, SSH-only firewall, redeploy-safe binary shipping and systemd install/restart
Secrets and environment variables injected into the `lightsail-instance` target via a remote `.env` + systemd `EnvironmentFile=`
HTTP and systemd health-check verification variants for the `lightsail-instance` target
Post-deploy health verification (HTTP retry probe) after a deployment reaches `ACTIVE`
Resolve and inject config secrets into the LightSail (container) target
Implement documented `${VAR}`/`${VAR:-default}` environment variable expansion in config parsing
